'''Ostor''' was an arid terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ostor system/Legends|Ostor system]], at the fringe of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]]. It was a barren planet composed of [[Color/Legends|red]] soil, deep canyons, and various wind-sculpted rock formations.

==Description==
[[File:CliffsofOstor.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Arid surface of Ostor.]]
Ostor was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SW:DV&CoS3" /> located in the [[Ostor system/Legends|eponymous system]] at the fridge of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] known as [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> positioned at the grid coordinates I-18.<ref name="EAOC" /> It orbited a [[Star/Legends|sun]] and possessed [[Gravity/Legends|standard gravity]], breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends#Type I atmospheres|Type I atmosphere]] and [[Temperature/Legends|arid climate]]. The surface of the planet was barren [[Color/Legends|red]] soil, deep canyons, and various wind-sculpted rock formations.<ref name="SW:DV&CoS3" />

==History==
In the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] holdout moved in to the planet, hoping to avoid the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the Galactic Empire discovered their presence, and sent several of their forces in a military operation called the [[Shrouded Offensive]] to both wipe out the Separatist holdouts and conquer the planet into the Empire. However, due to at least three mistakes made by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the operation proved to be one of the most disastrous for the Empire.
